root_cause: The legacy Right source resolves to OpenXR RightGrip. The authored sword had been aligned to UE grip +Z, but OpenXR grip -Z is the little-finger-to-thumb handle direction and UE converts this to +X.
fix: Rotate the entire right hand and socket-attached sword by +90 degrees about grip +Y. Use explicit RightGrip source. Keep projectile origin/direction on the controller pose.

expected.sword_qi: unchanged controller +X, now aligned to blade axis

evidence.detail: ToFVector returns (-z,x,y), so OpenXR -Z becomes UE +X

test_scope: Actual native BeginPlay, real hand mesh and grip animation, socket and weapon hierarchy, real combat sample positions under seven supplied controller rotations. No XR input emulation, save profile or encounter.
limitations: Compile and native automation are pending parent execution.
PICO physical controller acceptance must be performed in the headset.
